items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I got Barney in that little band. ... Then Barney played with me a while with the Maple Leaf Band.

ctx.x: Last Sunday, that was really melodic. That surprised me.

Well, by me, I guess, by me being an old-time drummer, and I practiced a lot, and I was taught the way I practiced, and the way I was taught to practice, caused me to be able to make the things that I make. Of course, it's not the modern runs of today, but those older runs, to me, sound better than the modern runs that they're making today, because lots of times, the drums break time, and they don't know what they be doing. That's right. They're just making those runs, and that's about it. But I count to my…
And how much older are you than Dominic? Are you about the same age as Barney?
